svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 07 · Riverside · 06/12 Mount Rubidoux (Uncommon)
svg.desc: A granite hill at the edge of downtown. People walk it at sunrise and catch their breath on top. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
